articles.headline: RIL to announce Q2 results on October 30, board to also consider fundraising
articles.summary: Reliance Industries will announce its September-quarter results on October 30, alongside considering fundraising through non-convertible debentures. Investors will track performance across O2C, telecom, retail and energy businesses amid share price weakness and market uncertainty.

articles.headline: Sebi extends deadline for debenture trustees to comply with norms till April 2027
articles.summary: Sebi has extended the deadline for debenture trustees to comply with regulatory requirements by six months. The new deadline for compliance is now set for April 27, 2027. This extension was granted after receiving industry feedback about operational challenges faced by debenture trustees. The regulator is currently reviewing the regulatory framework related to debenture trustees through an Expert Working Group.

articles.headline: Jio’s big-bang listing may give it stock market’s No.2 crown after Reliance Industries
articles.summary: Jio Platforms could overtake Bharti Airtel to become Indias second-largest listed company after its October 28 debut, with a 22% grey market premium implying a market capitalisation of Rs 12.5 lakh crore. Its Rs 30,213-crore IPO drew 22.2 times subscription, while brokerages highlighted growth opportunities in broadband, enterprise technology and AI.

articles.headline: Jio Platforms shares to list on BSE, NSE tomorrow;  GMP signals 22% premium
articles.summary: Jio Platforms shares are set to list on the BSE and NSE on October 28, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 22%. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was subscribed 22.19 times, led by strong institutional demand. Investors will watch the listing amid Jios growth ambitions and financial performance.

articles.headline: TCS, Infosys, other IT stocks drop up to 3% as Anthropic IPO sparks rally in global AI stocks
articles.summary: Indian IT stocks fell amid reports that Anthropic, the maker of Claude, is preparing for an IPO that could value it at around $1.5 trillion. While the listing would open up investment opportunities in a leading AI developer, rising infrastructure costs, mounting losses and concerns over growth sustainability remain key risks.

articles.headline: Sensex, Nifty close flat while small, midcaps rally. What analysts are saying?
articles.summary: During a day marked by volatility, Indian stock market indices Sensex and Nifty concluded with minor dips, primarily due to oil prices nearing $105 per barrel, instilling caution in the investment community. Conversely, the Nifty Smallcap and Midcap indices thrived, achieving noteworthy gains. Experts suggest that despite pullbacks in IT and private banking segments, the market holds attractive valuations.

articles.headline: Jio IPO delivers smaller payday for bankers than other mega offerings
articles.summary: In a landmark move, Jio Platforms, supported by Mukesh Ambani, successfully secured ₹30,213 crore, marking the largest IPO in Indias history. Investment bankers were rewarded with ₹196 crore in fees, translating to only 0.65% of the total amount raised. In contrast, Hyundai Motor India achieved ₹27,859 crore while paying out a heftier ₹493 crore in fees, which amount to 1.77%.

articles.headline: RBI data centre to strengthen payment systems, cyber resilience
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India inaugurated a new sovereign data centre to enhance the resilience of financial services and reduce reliance on third-party cloud providers. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also inaugurated a cybersecurity training institute, which will develop expertise in emerging technologies. The data centre will support critical systems like RTGS and NEFT for efficient financial transactions.

articles.headline: Investments in emerging sectors rise, but bank and NBFC financing remain limited: Report
articles.summary: Emerging sectors like AI, semiconductors, and defence are attracting significant investments while bank lending is limited. The financing patterns vary, with AI and space primarily funded through equity. Risks such as technology obsolescence and payment delays impact the lending sector significantly. Banks are encouraged to develop specialized financing strategies to support these sectors effectively. Over the next few years, demand is expected to shift towards storage and defence-related investments.
